description: Execution state of one AgentPlanStep. The state decides what TmAgentPlan paints (an icon plus the state in words) and which actions a step offers: a Failed step offers "Retry from this step", a Running one counts its live elapsed time, and a Skipped one is a terminal state that is neither a success nor a failure.

members.name: Running
members.description: Executing right now; the plan counts its elapsed time from StartedAt until CompletedAt is set.

members.name: Failed
members.description: Finished with an error; the step's Error carries the reason and the row offers Retry.

members.name: Skipped
members.description: Deliberately skipped — a terminal state that neither succeeded nor failed.
